# ghost/tasks

Tasks.org (F-Droid), local lists only: add a task, list open tasks, search, mark a task done. No account, no sync.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/tasks
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/tasks add_task --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/tasks list_tasks --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tasks search_tasks --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/tasks complete_task --device <serial> --param title=<title>
```

## Actions

- `add_task`: Add a task to water the plants
- `list_tasks`: What's on my to-do list?
- `search_tasks`: Find my task about stamps
- `complete_task`: Mark water plants as done
